annotations.title: Save a role or set its status

description: Use this to save a role to the person's tracker or record progress on it: saved, applied, oa, phone_screen, technical_interview, behavioral_interview, onsite, offer, rejected, withdrawn, ghosted, not_applied. On a role already tracked it replaces the current status (earlier statuses stay in the role's history).

job_id.description: The id of a search_jobs or get_my_feed row.

remarks.description: Optional note, e.g. the interviewer's name.
